[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] '''Lanish Ran''' was an undercover operative of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] who previously served under [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dessin]].<ref name="AJ1" />

==Biography==

At one time, he posed as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] in a repair center on [[Banir Avenue]] in the city of [[Forak]] on [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. He met the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Nakaron]] there.<ref name="AJ1" />

Later, Ran was assigned undercover in [[Glorga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] organization on [[Hollast VII]] as one of the gangster's lieutenants. Nakaron was also present in Glorga's court. Ran was determined to prove his loyalty to the Hutt, but worried that Nakaron would out him as an Alliance agent. Nakaron, for his part, believe Ran to by an Imperial spy and tried to prove it.<ref name="AJ1" />

During the [[Second Hollastin Insurrection]], Glorga the Hutt was attacked by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] looking to take advantage of the confusion. Nakaron defended Glorga and killed two of the smugglers, while Ran eliminated eight of them. Nakaron was convinced that Ran was an Imperial plant now, and tried to persuade Glorga while Ran was at the [[Spilgan complex]] shaking down port merchants. Glorga did not take kindly to Nakaron's accusation and exiled him. Nakaron promptly drew his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and killed the Hutt.<ref name="AJ1" />

Ran, unaware of what had transpired, found Nakaron targeting him next. The pair fought a forty-five minute battle across three floors of the Spilgan complex which left dozens of innocent bystanders dead. In the end, Ran was killed by Nakaron.<ref name="AJ1" />
